days_per_month.description: Days in a month (ADR 056), 1 when absent. Month and year are derived from the day number, never stored.

months_per_year.description: Months in a year (ADR 056), 1 when absent; a year is days_per_month * months_per_year days.

from.description: First day (inclusive), a day number from the start of the game. A window declares from/to or from_month/to_month, never both (ADR 056).

from_month.description: First month (inclusive): the window opens on day (from_month - 1) * days_per_month + 1.

to_month.description: Last month (inclusive): the window closes after day to_month * days_per_month.

label.description: A data/text key (for example "calendar.window.sow"), never player text: the viewer resolves it through TextTable (ADR 052).
